resources.string: Off. Nothing is sent to or heard from your network
Unlock the phone once after a restart to use this
On. No computer is paired yet
On. %1$d paired, none connected right now

Pairs this keyboard with a computer that runs KDE Connect, GSConnect or Valent, over your local network. The keyboard shows up there as its own device, so the KDE Connect app is not needed on the phone.
Look for paired computers and let them find this phone
Turns KDE Connect on. The keyboard looks for your paired computers on the network and lets them find this phone. Until it is on, nothing is sent or received.
Blank uses the phone\'s model followed by WM Keyboard. 32 characters, no punctuation

There is no background service. The link lives inside the keyboard, so after the keyboard hides it lasts only until Android pauses or closes the keyboard in the background. Many phones do that within minutes, some at once. Setting WM Keyboard\'s battery use to Unrestricted in Android\'s app settings keeps it up longer, but nothing guarantees it.
Only while the KDE Connect panel is open. The computer cannot type or send the clipboard at other times.
While the keyboard is on screen, and for a minute after.
Also after the keyboard hides, until Android pauses or closes it there, which on many phones is soon. Uses more battery.
Reconnect to paired computers when they are found
Reconnects to a paired computer as soon as it is found on the network, with no tap. This setting is on by default.
Text copied there is ready to paste here
Text that you copy on a paired computer arrives on this phone, ready to paste.
A password or code copied on the computer leaves this phone\'s clipboard after this long

Only text that looks like a password or a one-time code counts, the same check clipboard history uses. It is cleared only if it is still on the clipboard, and its copy in clipboard history goes too unless pinned. Other text from the computer stays.
Text copied here is ready to paste there
Passwords and codes are never sent by themselves. Nothing is sent from a password field, or while incognito pauses the clipboard. The Send tab can still send the clipboard when you ask.
Its keyboard types into the field, while this keyboard is showing and the phone is unlocked
Lets a paired computer\'s keyboard type into the text field on this phone. It works only while this keyboard is showing and the phone is unlocked.
Run its keys through this keyboard\'s layout, like a hardware keyboard
Off: what the computer sends is typed exactly. On: a Latin keyboard on the desk writes Bengali through Avro, and suggestions and autocorrect apply.
How far the computer\'s pointer moves for a move of your finger on the touchpad. At 1 it moves at the normal speed.
Slow moves are precise, fast moves go far

A slow move of your finger moves the pointer a short way, for precise work, and a fast move takes it far. With this off, the pointer always moves in the same proportion. This setting is on by default.
How far the computer scrolls for a move of two fingers on the touchpad. At 1 it scrolls at the normal speed.
The page moves in the direction of your fingers, as on a phone. With this off, the page moves the opposite way, like a mouse wheel. This setting is on by default.
Two fingers for right click, three for middle
A tap on the touchpad is a click. A tap with two fingers is a right click, and a tap with three is a middle click. This setting is on by default.
The phone gives a short tick when the touchpad sends a click. This setting is on by default.
Saved to Downloads, in WM Keyboard, and added to the clipboard history
Files that a paired computer sends are saved to Downloads, in the WM Keyboard folder, and added to the clipboard history. This setting is on by default.
Other apps can share to the computer. Only shown once a computer is paired
Adds your paired computer to the share menu of other apps, so you can send a file or a link to it from any app. It shows only after a computer is paired. This setting is on by default.
The computer shows this phone\'s charge
Tells the paired computer this phone\'s battery level, so the computer can show it. This setting is on by default.
A verification code that arrives here is offered on the computer too

When a code arrives in a notification, the phone sends the code alone to the paired computer, never the message it came in. WM Keyboard on the computer offers it above the cursor, and a KDE Connect desktop shows it as a notification. Everything stays on your local network. This needs Codes from notifications on, under Typing, because that is what reads the notifications.
The computer can pause and skip what plays here
Lets the paired computer see what plays on this phone, and pause it or skip to the next track.
Granted. Needed to see what is playing
Needed to see what is playing. Tap to grant
If the computer does not show up

1. Both devices are on the same network. Mobile data and most guest Wi-Fi do not work.
2. KDE Connect is running on the computer.
3. Its firewall allows ports 1714 to 1764, for TCP and UDP.
4. Still nothing: add the computer by its IP address on the Devices screen.
Paired computers, and the ones nearby
Turn KDE Connect on to look for computers
Looking… Open KDE Connect on the computer

A computer with WMK Desktop shows a pairing code under Backup & restore › Sync devices › Pair a phone. Point this phone\'s camera at it and open the link: WM Keyboard opens here and pairs, with no code to compare.
Clipboard paused until you resume it
Waiting for %1$s. Accept on the computer if it shows this code
%1$s wants to pair. Accept only if it shows this code

A link asks this phone to pair with the computer at %1$s. A paired computer can type into the field you use, get the text you copy, and send files. Pair only if you scanned this code from your own computer.
For networks that block discovery. This phone announces itself to each address directly, and the computer answers.
KDE Connect is off in WM Keyboard
Those files could not be read
A pair request, a file or a ping that arrived while the keyboard was hidden
Shows a notification when a paired computer sends a pair request, a file or a ping while the keyboard is hidden. With this off, you see these only when the keyboard is open.
